text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_thermal_stability_screen_v3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before session"},{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO_glass_P118"},"comment":"standard FTO plate, routine swap"},{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO_glass_P118"},"comment":"init per SOP"},{"server":"deposition","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,25,0,0,5,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":120},"comment":"NiFeCoMn baseline, nominal thickness"},{"server":"furnace","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":690,"duration":240,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"label: standard crystallization step, within approved window (setpoint units per furnace calibration offset)"},{"server":"potentiostat","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12,"y":7},"comment":"select spot for CP"},{"server":"potentiostat","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,25,0,0,5,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"routine CP at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"potentiostat","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,25,0,0,5,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":72},"comment":"standard stability hold"},{"server":"analysis","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"model":"gp_oer_overpotential"},"comment":"ingest results"}]}
